widgets_values: Modify the color of a part of the product.Ultra-realistic product color adjustment.  Changes the color of only selected areas from the original color to the target color, while strictly preserving the rest of the image.  Completely preserves all original material properties, gloss, reflection, micro-texture, highlights, and shadows.  No distortion, shape alteration, smoothing, or addition of new textures.  Color transitions must be natural, soft, seamless, and without color bleeding.  Preserves the atmosphere, lighting direction, intensity, ambient color, and contrast of the original photograph.  True commercial-grade realism, high detail fidelity, and physically accurate surface response.  Recolored areas must appear to blend naturally, consistent with the original ambient lighting and material surface treatment.

To make flat objects appear three-dimensional and voluminous, matching the lighting and shadow relationships of the environment.
Ignoring all lighting, shadows, reflections, and color casts in the original product image, the product is re-rendered as an independent subject.

Refined, sophisticated lighting is reconstructed in the target scene: A soft light base is used overall, but directional hard light, reminiscent of luxury advertising, is added to illuminate key surfaces of the product.
Highlights are clear and bright, while shadows are deep and clean, presenting a rich and sophisticated visual effect.

Low-intensity ambient light spillover and soft diffuse reflection are applied to maintain the clarity and brightness characteristic of e-commerce visuals.

Simultaneously, fine and sharp highlights, micro-reflective details, and light shaping are added to the product surface,

giving the material the texture and depth of luxury advertising.

The product's geometry and proportions remain completely unchanged.

Natural, ground-hugging contact shadows are generated for the product, while slightly hardened directional projections are added.

The edges of the shadows are moderately softened, achieving a balance between the natural feel of e-commerce soft lighting and the textured contrast of luxury hard lighting.

Generate sophisticated yet understated reflections on smooth surfaces, water, glass, or metal environments:
Smooth surfaces produce clear yet controlled reflections; semi-gloss surfaces offer softened reflections; all reflection directions are strictly matched to the main light source.

Add subtle and natural secondary reflections to the product, making highlights more three-dimensional and shadows cleaner;

Achieve a blend of high-end texture, sharp contours, and a soft, luminous atmosphere.

Finally, achieve a seamless blending effect with high resolution, refined lighting, clean backgrounds, and a combination of realistic soft light and sophisticated hard light, meeting e-commerce standards while possessing a luxury-movie-level quality.

Strictly maintain the product's original color, hue, tone, and color proportions; alteration of the product's inherent color is not permitted.

When rematching lighting, only adjust the light and shadow relationships, without changing the color category or value itself.
